title: Inspect Active Tote State With GetToteTask
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client to submit the GET GetToteTask request and inspect the current active state of totes.
when_to_use: Use when L2 or L3 support needs to inspect the live active state of tote tasks through the OptiSweep / WCS API using Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client.
not_for: Removing a tote from the system.
Resending a tote task to the Robotics database model.
Interpreting response fields or HTTP response codes not defined in the source.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2 support performs the API inspection using the OptiSweep / WCS API and Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client.
L3 support reviews or assists when the request cannot be opened or submitted, or when the returned information does not show tote task state.
safety_notes: Use the GET GetToteTask request for state inspection. Do not substitute tote-changing requests such as RemoveTote, InitializeTote, Exchange Tote, or Update Exchange Settings.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog or equivalent WCS API client

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep / WCS API
Access to Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client
system_preconditions: The Totes API area is available in the API client.
The GET GetToteTask request is available.

steps.title: Open the Totes API area in Apidog
steps.purpose: Navigate to the live OptiSweep / WCS API request collection containing the tote inspection request.
steps.instruction: In Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client, open the OptiSweep / WCS API and select the Totes API area.
steps.expected_result: The Totes API area is open and the GET GetToteTask request is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The API client displays the Totes requests and includes GET GetToteTask.
steps.failure_condition: The OptiSweep / WCS API or Totes API area cannot be opened, or GET GetToteTask is not visible.

actions.label: Open Totes API
actions.exact_action: Open the OptiSweep / WCS API client, such as Apidog, and open the Totes API area.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate to L3 support if the GetToteTask request cannot be opened.

steps.title: Submit the GET GetToteTask request
steps.purpose: Request the current tote-task information from the OptiSweep / WCS API.
steps.instruction: Open GET GetToteTask and submit it using the request controls available in Apidog or the equivalent WCS API client.

steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be submitted or returns no tote-task information that can be reviewed.

steps.title: Review the returned active tote state
steps.purpose: Determine whether the API response provides the current active state of tote tasks.
steps.instruction: Review the returned tote-task information from GET GetToteTask for the active state of the totes.

steps.healthy_condition: The response contains tote-task information that identifies the active state of the totes.
